definition: Primary source system contributing the imaging record.
notes: Examples include IDA, Diverse VCID MRI, DVR, and A4 historical imaging.
derivation_logic: Directly carried or standardized from the contributing source data; see Definition and Notes.

definition: Pipeline-generated unique key for the canonical availability record.
notes: Used to test record uniqueness within the integrated master.
derivation_logic: Pipeline-generated unique key for the canonical integrated record; source-specific stable identifiers are preferred when available.

definition: Source file or files contributing to the record.
notes: Multiple files may support a canonical record.
derivation_logic: Directly carried or standardized from the contributing source data; see Definition and Notes.

definition: Study/project labels associated with the record.
notes: May contain multiple projects when one image is represented in more than one study.
derivation_logic: Directly carried or standardized from the contributing source data; see Definition and Notes.

definition: Original source-specific subject identifier values.
notes: Not assumed to be UDS IDs unless validated by the identity pipeline.
derivation_logic: Directly carried or standardized from the contributing source data; see Definition and Notes.

definition: Harmonized USC ADRC UDS ID. PTID is equivalent to UDS ID.
notes: Preferred linkage identifier when populated.
derivation_logic: Assigned only from validated direct UDS/PTID evidence, approved crosswalks, or unambiguous identity propagation; unresolved identities remain blank rather than guessed.

definition: NACC participant identifier when available.
notes: Resolved only through validated identity sources.
derivation_logic: Carried from validated source/crosswalk evidence associated with the harmonized participant identity.

definition: Whether the harmonized UDS/PTID is verifiably present in the official USC NACC identifier registry.
notes: Distinguishes official NACC registry membership from an identifier that merely resembles a UDS/PTID.
derivation_logic: TRUE when the harmonized UDS/PTID is present in the official USC NACC identifier export used for the run; otherwise FALSE.

definition: Participant GUID when available.
notes: May be blank in current source exports.
derivation_logic: Directly carried or standardized from the contributing source data; see Definition and Notes.

definition: Brain Research Study identifier from MAP when available.
notes: MAP subject_id and subject_core are not used as imaging identity aliases.
derivation_logic: Directly carried or standardized from the contributing source data; see Definition and Notes.

definition: Medical record number when available from approved linkage sources.
notes: Internal/sensitive linkage identifier; consider removing for external release if not needed.
derivation_logic: Directly carried or standardized from the contributing source data; see Definition and Notes.

definition: Autopsy number when available from MAP.
notes: Convenience linkage field.
derivation_logic: Directly carried or standardized from the contributing source data; see Definition and Notes.

definition: Imaging acquisition/study date when available.
notes: Preferred date for longitudinal availability.
derivation_logic: Directly carried or standardized from the contributing source data; see Definition and Notes.

definition: Repository/archive date when available.
notes: Should not be substituted for study_date as the acquisition date.
derivation_logic: Directly carried or standardized from the contributing source data; see Definition and Notes.

definition: Detailed harmonized imaging modality.
notes: Examples: MRI, DTI, fMRI, Amyloid PET, Tau PET, FDG PET, PET unclassified, CT.
derivation_logic: Standardized from source modality plus protocol/description evidence. PET is classified as amyloid, tau, FDG/other, or unclassified only when supported; MRI-family distinctions are retained.

definition: MRI-family subtype: MRI, DTI, or fMRI.
notes: Blank for non-MRI records.
derivation_logic: For MRI-family records, derived as MRI, DTI, or fMRI from explicit source modality/series type or strong protocol/description evidence; blank for non-MRI records.

definition: Broad analysis grouping.
notes: MRI/DTI/fMRI roll up to MRI without losing subtype; PET remains type-specific where defensible.
derivation_logic: Broad roll-up: MRI/DTI/fMRI -> MRI; amyloid and tau PET remain separate; FDG/unclassified PET -> Other PET; other modalities -> Other imaging.

definition: Normalized MRI sequence evidence when identifiable.
notes: Examples include DTI, FLAIR, T2, T2*, 3D T1, and ASL.
derivation_logic: Normalized sequence labels inferred conservatively from source modality, series type, description, protocol, or MRI-2 sequence flags; multiple supported sequences are semicolon-delimited.

definition: Scanner magnetic field strength when available.
notes: Standardized from source metadata where possible.
derivation_logic: Directly carried or standardized from the contributing source data; see Definition and Notes.

definition: Scanner manufacturer when available.
notes: Standardized across sources where possible.
derivation_logic: Directly carried or standardized from the contributing source data; see Definition and Notes.

definition: Scanner model when available.
notes: Standardized across sources where possible.
derivation_logic: Directly carried or standardized from the contributing source data; see Definition and Notes.

definition: Compact MRI QC information when supplied by source data.
notes: Source-specific detailed QC remains in provenance artifacts.
derivation_logic: Directly carried or standardized from the contributing source data; see Definition and Notes.

definition: PET tracer inferred/extracted from protocol or description when available.
notes: Used to support PET type classification.
derivation_logic: Extracted or normalized from explicit tracer/radiopharmaceutical/protocol text when available; not inferred from ambiguous labels alone.

definition: IDA Image ID when available.
notes: Primary image-level duplicate signal within IDA.
derivation_logic: Directly carried or standardized from the contributing source data; see Definition and Notes.

definition: Source scan/image description.
notes: Useful for protocol and classification review.
derivation_logic: Directly carried or standardized from the contributing source data; see Definition and Notes.

definition: Source imaging protocol text when available.
notes: Used for tracer, modality, and scanner metadata derivation.
derivation_logic: Directly carried or standardized from the contributing source data; see Definition and Notes.

definition: Granularity represented by the row.
notes: Common values include image_or_source_row and session_availability.
derivation_logic: Classified as image/source-row when the source represents an image/series record, or session_availability when the source supplies only dated session availability.

definition: Method or methods used to resolve identity to UDS/PTID.
notes: Supports mapping audit.
derivation_logic: Concatenates the validated identity-resolution method(s) supporting the harmonized UDS/PTID.

definition: Source evidence supporting identity resolution.
notes: Supports mapping audit.
derivation_logic: Concatenates the source/crosswalk evidence used for identity resolution.

definition: Whether contradictory identity evidence was detected.
notes: Conflicts are surfaced rather than guessed.
derivation_logic: TRUE only when competing validated identity evidence points to different UDS/PTIDs; conflicting cases are not silently resolved.

definition: Number of source rows represented by the canonical record.
notes: Can exceed one when duplicate source representations are consolidated.
derivation_logic: Count of raw/source representations consolidated into the canonical integrated record.

definition: Number of distinct source projects represented by the canonical record.
notes: Useful for cross-project duplicate representation.
derivation_logic: Count of distinct contributing source projects represented by the canonical record.

definition: How the record entered the integrated availability dataset.
notes: Distinguishes canonical IDA records from additional non-IDA availability.
derivation_logic: Assigned from the integration path, distinguishing canonical image/source records from additional non-IDA session availability and corroborated source evidence.

definition: Best-available canonical subject key used within the release.
notes: Uses UDS/PTID first, then NACCID, then a source-specific namespace.
derivation_logic: Uses UDS/PTID when available; otherwise NACCID; otherwise a namespaced source-specific subject identity.

definition: Identity namespace used for subject_key.
notes: UDS/PTID, NACCID, or source-specific ID.
derivation_logic: Records which identity namespace supplied subject_key (UDS/PTID, NACCID, or source-specific).

definition: Harmonized USC ADRC UDS ID/PTID when available.
notes: Blank does not mean the imaging record is invalid; only that UDS linkage is unresolved.
derivation_logic: Assigned only from validated direct UDS/PTID evidence, approved crosswalks, or unambiguous identity propagation; unresolved identities remain blank rather than guessed.

definition: NACCID when available.
notes: May identify subjects that do not yet have a resolved UDS/PTID.
derivation_logic: Carried from validated source/crosswalk evidence associated with the harmonized participant identity.

definition: Whether the subject's UDS/PTID is present in the official USC NACC identifier registry.
notes: Official NACC-registry verification flag.
derivation_logic: TRUE when the harmonized UDS/PTID is present in the official USC NACC identifier export used for the run; otherwise FALSE.

definition: GUID when available.
notes: May be blank.
derivation_logic: Directly carried or standardized from the contributing source data; see Definition and Notes.

definition: BRS identifier when available.
notes: Internal linkage field.
derivation_logic: Directly carried or standardized from the contributing source data; see Definition and Notes.

definition: MRN when available.
notes: Internal/sensitive linkage field.
derivation_logic: Directly carried or standardized from the contributing source data; see Definition and Notes.

definition: Autopsy number when available.
notes: Internal linkage field.
derivation_logic: Directly carried or standardized from the contributing source data; see Definition and Notes.

definition: Source-specific subject IDs represented for the subject.
notes: Semicolon-delimited when multiple values exist.
derivation_logic: Distinct source-specific subject identifiers for the subject are collapsed with semicolons.

definition: Source systems contributing imaging for the subject.
notes: Semicolon-delimited when multiple sources contribute.
derivation_logic: Distinct contributing source systems are collapsed with semicolons.

definition: Projects contributing imaging for the subject.
notes: Semicolon-delimited when multiple projects contribute.
derivation_logic: Distinct contributing projects are collapsed with semicolons.

definition: Total number of integrated imaging-availability records for the subject.
notes: Includes image/source-row records and session-level availability records.
derivation_logic: Count of integrated master records contributing to the subject or subject/date/modality grouping.

definition: Number of image/source-row granularity records for the subject.
notes: Closest available measure of total image/scan records where sources provide image-level detail.
derivation_logic: Count of contributing records classified as image_or_source_row.

definition: Number of session-level availability records for the subject.
notes: Used by non-image-level sources such as historical availability tables.
derivation_logic: Count of contributing records classified as session_availability.

definition: Number of records with a populated study_date.
derivation_logic: Count of contributing records with nonmissing study_date.

definition: Number of distinct populated imaging dates.
derivation_logic: Number of distinct nonmissing study_date values for the subject.

definition: Earliest available imaging date.
derivation_logic: Minimum nonmissing study_date within the relevant subject grouping.

definition: Latest available imaging date.
derivation_logic: Maximum nonmissing study_date within the relevant subject grouping.

definition: Subject has at least one MRI-family record.
notes: Includes MRI, DTI, and fMRI.
derivation_logic: TRUE when at least one contributing record has analysis_modality_group = MRI.

definition: Subject has at least one record explicitly classified as conventional/unspecified MRI.
notes: Does not include DTI/fMRI unless a separate conventional MRI record exists.
derivation_logic: TRUE when at least one contributing record is explicitly classified as detailed_modality = MRI; DTI/fMRI alone do not set this flag.

definition: Subject has at least one DTI record.
derivation_logic: TRUE when at least one contributing record has detailed_modality = DTI.

definition: Subject has at least one fMRI record.
derivation_logic: TRUE when at least one contributing record has detailed_modality = fMRI.

definition: Subject has at least one Amyloid PET record.
derivation_logic: TRUE when at least one contributing record has detailed_modality = Amyloid PET.

definition: Subject has at least one Tau PET record.
derivation_logic: TRUE when at least one contributing record has detailed_modality = Tau PET.

definition: Subject has at least one FDG or unclassified/other PET record.
derivation_logic: TRUE when at least one contributing record has analysis_modality_group = Other PET.

definition: Subject has at least one PET record of any harmonized type.
derivation_logic: TRUE when at least one contributing record is Amyloid PET, Tau PET, or Other PET.

definition: Subject has at least one non-MRI/non-PET imaging record retained by the pipeline.
notes: Examples include CT.
derivation_logic: TRUE when at least one contributing record has analysis_modality_group = Other imaging.

definition: Whether the subject has a harmonized UDS ID/PTID.
notes: Useful for linkage to other USC ADRC datasets.
derivation_logic: TRUE when a harmonized UDS/PTID is populated for the subject.

definition: Best-available canonical subject key.
notes: See Subject-Level Availability definition.
derivation_logic: Uses UDS/PTID when available; otherwise NACCID; otherwise a namespaced source-specific subject identity.

definition: Source systems supporting this longitudinal availability record.

definition: Number of distinct populated IDA Image IDs represented.
